hawasice.name: Hawas Ice
hawasice.research_note: Fragrantica: Aromatic, for men, 2023; 'Cardamon' is Fragrantica's spelling. Rasasi's Saudi store (HAWAS ICE 100 ML, 'FOR HIM') gives essentially the same pyramid plus one extra heart note: Top Frozen Apple, Bergamot Italy, Lemon Italy, Star Anise China; Heart Orange Blossom, Marine Accord Iced, Plum, Cardamom Ceylan; Base 'Crystral Moss', Drift Wood, 'Ambar', Musk. The Amazon.sa listing bullets give a different pyramid that matches neither (Top bergamot, lemon, mint; Heart orange blossom, cardamom, plum, blackcurrant; Base patchouli, amber, tonka, sandalwood); treat the Amazon bullets as unreliable. Gender: Fragrantica and Rasasi's product title say men/For Him, but the Rasasi store's product category field says UNISEX and Amazon.sa's department field says unisex.

supremacycollector.name: Supremacy Collector's Edition Pour Homme
supremacycollector.research_note: Fragrantica: Chypre Fruity, for men, 2024, perfumer Imran Fazlani. Afnan's UAE site (Type Eau De Parfum, 100 ML, Orientation Pour Homme) gives the same notes: Opening Pineapple, Bergamot, Apple, White Floral; Heart Orange Blossom, Birch, Amber; Dry-down Oak Moss, Musk, Ambergris. The Amazon.sa listing (ASIN B07WC5V4QN) gives no note list, only 'Smoky woods and citrus'; its Date First Available is 11 November 2024. A UK retailer titles it 'for Unisex' in search results (not read); Afnan markets it Pour Homme.

najdia.name: Najdia
najdia.research_note: Fragrantica: Aromatic Aquatic, for women and men, 2020. The Amazon.sa listing (ASIN B01N4JN1U1) bullets give the same notes as Fragrantica in a different order, and its A+ text calls it 'Najdia Silver ... Men's Eau de Parfum'. DISAGREEMENT: Lattafa's own product page (Size 100 ML, Fragrance type: Men) lists a different pyramid: Top Grapefruit, 'Mandarian'; Heart Spicy Notes, Rose, Cinnamon; Base Amber, Leather, Patchouli, Woody Notes. The same page's description copies Fragrantica's 'Aromatic Aquatic ... for women and men' sentence and mentions gift-set contents, so the page looks mis-edited, but it is the house's own listing. YEAR DOUBT: Amazon.sa gives Date First Available 9 February 2018, earlier than Fragrantica's 2020. Parfumo's Najdia page showed implausible data (e.g. notes 'Diagonal Sandalwood', 'Hexagonal Frangipani', perfumer David Seth Moltz) and was disregarded. Not to be confused with Najdia Intense (2024), Najdia in Gold, Najdia Tribute or Oud Najdia, which have separate Fragrantica pages.

nauticavoyage.name: Voyage
nauticavoyage.research_note: Parfumo agrees on the pyramid (Apple, Leaves / Lotus, Mimosa / Moss, Musk, Cedar, Amber). Fragrantica page does not state the concentration; EDT is from Parfumo.

swyabsolutely.name: Stronger With You Absolutely
swyabsolutely.research_note: Launched February 2021 as a 30/50/100 ml Eau de Parfum (Fragrantica news). Concentration naming disagrees across sources: Notino UK lists the concentration as "perfume" (Parfum), and Armani Beauty US/UK product pages are titled "Stronger With You Absolutely Parfum" (seen only in search-result titles; both official pages returned 403), while Boots, Walmart and Jomashop listings (search-result titles only) say Eau de Parfum. Treat as the same juice; not verified whether the label changed. Parfumo pyramid agrees in substance (Rum, Elemi resin, Bergamot / Davana, Lavender / Marron glace, Bourbon vanilla, Cedarwood, Patchouli): it says Bourbon vanilla where Fragrantica says Madagascar Vanilla, and Marron glace for Chestnut. Fragrantica writes "elemi" in lower case.

bossbottlednight.name: Boss Bottled Night
bossbottlednight.research_note: Disagreement: Parfumo lists Top Lavender, Birch leaf; Heart African violet, Cardamom, Jasmine; Base Salmwood, Musky notes, Sandalwood. Fragrantica: Top Lavender, Birch; Middle Violet; Base Woodsy Notes, Musk. Fragrantica description says the base is Louro Amarelo wood and musk, and lists the range as EDT 40/100 ml.

hugoman.name: Hugo Man
hugoman.source: the 2021 relaunch, the bottle sold now (Fragrantica 64606, Coty's pyramid)
hugoman.research_note: IDENTITY: Fragrantica keeps two pages. "Hugo" (1995, Bob Aliano, page 570) is the original, used here. "Hugo Man" (2021, page 64606) is a Coty relaunch from January 2021 with an updated flask bottle and a different, shorter pyramid: Top Green Apple; Middle Lavender; Base Pine, Woody Notes, Balsam Fir (accords woody, aromatic, conifer, fresh spicy, fresh, lavender). Bottles now sold as "HUGO Man" are likely the 2021 version; which one a given listing is cannot be told from the name. Parfumo pyramid for the 1995 EDT is longer and differs: Top Green apple, Cedar leaf, Pine needle, Grapefruit, Mint, Thyme, Basil, Rum; Heart Cedarwood, Geranium leaf, Lavender, Sage, Carnation, Jasmine; Base Fir balsam, Moss, Vetiver, Sandalwood, Suede. Fragrantica page does not state the concentration; EDT is from Parfumo.

mostwantedintense.name: The Most Wanted Eau de Parfum Intense
mostwantedintense.research_note: YEAR: 2021, not 2022. Fragrantica news (23 April 2021) says it was available as a 50 and 100 ml Eau de Parfum Intense from April 2021; Parfumo also gives 2021. The Fragrantica page is titled only "The Most Wanted" and shows no year. The 2022 release in the line is The Most Wanted Parfum (Parfumo 2022; Fragrantica page 73664: Ginger / Woodsy Notes / Bourbon Vanilla). EDT INTENSE is a different product: Fragrantica page 90953 "The Most Wanted Intense" (2024, Nicolas Bonneville and Honorine Blanc; its description calls it The Most Wanted Eau de Toilette Intense): Top Bergamot; Middle Lavender; Base Liquor, Moss; accords lavender, citrus, fresh spicy, aromatic, mossy, alcohol. Parfumo also dates the EDT Intense to 2024, not 2021. AMAZON.SA "The Most Wanted Intense EDP 100 ml": the only product in the line that is both Intense and EDP is this 2021 Eau de Parfum Intense (sold in 100 ml), so the listing should be this one; the listing itself was not read. PYRAMID DISAGREEMENT: Fragrantica page and Fragrantica news (quoting the brand) give Cardamom / Toffee (caramel) / Amberwood; Parfumo gives Guatemala cardamom / Toffee / Bourbon vanilla, Vetiver. Azzaro official page read but it lists no notes.

trueinstinct.name: True Instinct
trueinstinct.source: the brand's pyramid (Coty and Parfumo agree); Fragrantica's is longer and unsupported
trueinstinct.research_note: CONCENTRATION: exists as Eau de Parfum. The official Beckham Fragrances (Coty) page names it "True Instinct Eau de Parfum" and lists the range as EDP 75 ml, EDP 50 ml and a 150 ml deodorant body spray; no EDT was found, so the Amazon.sa "Eau De Parfum 75ML" listing matches the official range. YEAR: 2023 from Parfumo only; the Fragrantica page shows no year. PYRAMID DISAGREEMENT: Fragrantica lists Top Pine, Basil; Middle Geranium, Sandalwood; Base Patchouli, Vetiver, Musk. The brand page (pine needles in the opening, cedarwood in the heart, vetiver in the dry down) and Parfumo (Pine needle / Cedarwood / Vetiver) agree with each other and not with Fragrantica. A Parfumo user review says it is sold as "Pulsing Instinct" in some regions (unverified).

thescentmen.name: Boss The Scent
thescentmen.research_note: Launched end of August 2015 as 50/100 ml EDT (Fragrantica description). Parfumo names it "The Scent for Him" and lists a shorter pyramid: Ginger / Maninka fruit / Leather.

guiltyabsolute.name: Guilty Absolute pour Homme
guiltyabsolute.research_note: Fragrantica page title is "Gucci Guilty Absolute"; Parfumo names it "Guilty Absolute pour Homme". Fragrantica description: available as 90 and 150 ml Eau de Parfum. Parfumo gives only a flat list: Woodleather, Goldenwood, Nootka cypress, Patchouli, Vetiver (no pyramid).

emblem.name: Emblem
emblem.research_note: Fragrantica description: launched spring 2014 with Emblem Intense, both as 40/60/100 ml EDT. Parfumo pyramid agrees (Cardamom, Clary sage, Grapefruit / Violet leaf, Cinnamon leaf / Tonka bean, Woody notes).

lhommeidealedp.name: L'Homme Idéal Eau de Parfum
lhommeidealedp.research_note: Parfumo pyramid is shorter: Almond, Spices, Bergamot / Vanilla, Bulgarian rose, Frankincense / Tonka bean, Leathery notes, Sandalwood (no lavender, rosemary, thyme or cherry). Fragrantica description text names Turkish rose in the heart while its pyramid says Bulgarian Rose.

euphoriamen.name: Euphoria Men
euphoriamen.research_note: Parfumo adds notes: Top Pepper, Ginger, Rain accord, Sudachi; Heart Cedar leaf, Sage, Black basil; Base Amber, Patchouli, Redwood, Suede. Fragrantica page does not state the concentration; EDT is from Parfumo.

oudmalaki.name: Oud Malaki
oudmalaki.research_note: Fragrantica: Woody Spicy, for men, 2012, perfumer Dominique Ropion. Chopard's own page (Men's Fragrances, 80 ML Eau de Parfum) gives no pyramid, but its description names grapefruit, lavender, herbal Artemisia, tobacco and spices with oud, which is consistent with Fragrantica. The same page lists the other Malaki scents (Leather, Rose, Tobacco, Black Incense and Cedar Malaki). A Golden Scent listing is titled 'for women and men' in search results (not read); Chopard markets it for men.

yaramoi.name: Yara Moi
yaramoi.source: Lattafa's own pyramid (lattafa.com and lattafa-usa.com agree); Fragrantica's shares two notes with it
yaramoi.research_note: MAJOR DISAGREEMENT. Fragrantica (for women, 2022): Top Jasmine, Peach; Middle Caramel, Amber; Base Patchouli, Sandalwood. Lattafa's own pages (lattafa.com: Size 100 ML, Fragrance type Women; lattafa-usa.com the same) list a different pyramid: Top Pear, Pink Pepper, Black Currant (spelled 'Black Current'); Middle Tuberose (spelled 'Tubercose'), Jasmine, Almond; Base Vanilla, Cashmeran, Patchouli. Only Jasmine and Patchouli overlap. The house's list is the manufacturer's claim; Fragrantica's is the preferred source under this brief. Decide which to use before publishing. Concentration: lattafa.com does not state it for the 100 ml spray; 'Eau de Parfum' comes from the Amazon.com listing title seen in search results only (lattafa-usa also sells a separate 20 ml pure concentrated perfume oil). Parfumo's Yara Moi page showed implausible note names (e.g. 'Echoed Elemi', 'Backwards Bergamot') and was disregarded.

cdnwoman.name: Club de Nuit Woman
cdnwoman.research_note: IDENTITY: Club de Nuit Woman and Club de Nuit Intense Woman are two different perfumes, and both are sold in 105 ml (3.6 oz), so the size does not tell them apart; the notes do. The Amazon.sa listing 'Armaf Club De Nuit Perfume for Women Eau De Parfum 105ML' (ASIN B00CLF6K3I; model name CLUB DE NUIT; A+ text 'Armaf Club De Nuit Femme', 'Floral Fruity') lists Top Bergamot, Grapefruit, Peach, Orange; Middle Geranium, Jasmine, Litchi, Rose; Base Musk, Patchouli, Vanilla, Vetiver. That matches Fragrantica's Club de Nuit Woman (Floral Fruity) and Armaf's own Club De Nuit Woman page (EDP; 30, 105, 200 ml and other sizes). So the listing is Club de Nuit Woman. For contrast, Club de Nuit Intense Woman (Fragrantica page titled 'Club de Nuit Intense', for women, Chypre Floral; Armaf's page gives the same notes) is Top Rose, Saffron, Geranium; Middle Nutmeg, Pepper, Violet, Caraway; Base Patchouli, Agarwood (Oud), Vanilla, Amber. No launch year on Fragrantica or Armaf. The Amazon.sa page showed 19,230 ratings. Other variants with separate Fragrantica pages (Woman Extrait 2025, Woman Extreme Edition 2025, Woman Perfume Oil 2022, Lionheart Woman 2025) are different products.

amaali.name: Amaali
amaali.research_note: Fragrantica: Floral Woody Musk, for women, in its Concentrated Perfume Oils collection, no year. Swiss Arabian's UAE site (CPO 15ML; 'Amaali for her is a concentrated perfume oil'; family Woody, Fruity, Gourmand) gives the same notes: Top Pineapple, Lemon, Apple; Middle Jasmine, Rose; Base Cedarwood, Sandal, Musk, Vanilla, Amber, Caramel. Jomashop titles it 'Unisex' in search results (not read); the house markets it for women.

ckin2uher.name: CK IN2U Her
ckin2uher.research_note: Fragrantica page read directly in a browser (WebFetch returned 403). Parfumo has the same pyramid except the base lists 'Ambergris' where Fragrantica lists 'Amber'. Fragrantica gives no concentration; Nice One sells it as Eau de Toilette 100ml. Parfumo says production was apparently discontinued. Fragrantica shows 8 accords; the first 6 are given. Perfumers per Fragrantica: Bruno Jovanovic, Jean-Marc Chaillan, Loc Dong, Carlos Benaim.

ckbeauty.name: Beauty
ckbeauty.research_note: Fragrantica, Parfumo (Ambrette / Jasmine / Cedarwood) and Perfume Direct (Ambrette Seeds / Jasmine / Cedar) agree on a three-note pyramid. DISAGREEMENT: The Perfume Shop lists a longer pyramid: top Citrus cocktail, Orange blossom; heart Jasmine, Neo-lily; base Cedarwood, Ambrette seeds (ambrette moves to the base). Fragrantica shows only 5 accords. The EDP is the 2010 original; Sheer Beauty (id sheerbeauty) is the later EDT edition.

eternitymoment.name: Eternity Moment
eternitymoment.research_note: FragranceX gives the same notes as Fragrantica (melon, litchi, guava, raspberry / passion flower, peony, water lily, jasmine / sandalwood, cashmere wood, musk, Brazilian rosewood). DISAGREEMENT: Parfumo lists top Lychee, Guava, Pomegranate blossom; heart Peony, Water lily, Jasmine, Passion flower; base Musk, Raspberry, Rosewood (raspberry in the base, no melon, cashmere wood or sandalwood). A search snippet from other US retailers (Miles Kimball/Walter Drake, not read) matches the Parfumo version plus cashmere. Fragrantica's own description text also mentions pomegranate blossom, which is not in its pyramid. The Nice One concentration evidence is the product title as listed on the Nice One page read (https://niceonesa.com/en/calvin-klein-ckin2u-for-women-eau-de-toilette-100ml-n5567); the product page itself (https://niceonesa.com/en/calvin-klein-eternity-moment-for-women-eau-de-parfum-100ml-n956) was not opened.

sheerbeauty.name: Sheer Beauty
sheerbeauty.research_note: YEAR DIFFERS FROM THE BRIEF: Fragrantica and Parfumo both give 2012, not 2011; Fragrantica says it was available from January 2012 as 30, 50 and 100 ml Eau de Toilette (a late-2011 announcement is possible but not seen). Parfumo pyramid agrees (Red berries, Bellini, Bergamot / Pink lily, Peony, Jasmine / Musk, Vanilla blossom, Sandalwood). Fragrantica spells the base note 'Vanille'. Nice One title reads 'Eau De Toilette'. The Nice One concentration evidence is the product title as listed on the Nice One page read (https://niceonesa.com/en/calvin-klein-ckin2u-for-women-eau-de-toilette-100ml-n5567); the product page itself (https://niceonesa.com/en/calvin-klein-sheer-beauty-for-women-eau-de-toilette-n1250) was not opened.

euphoriawomen.name: Euphoria
euphoriawomen.research_note: Parfumo (Eau de Parfum, 2005) agrees: Pomegranate, Green notes, Persimmon / Black orchid, Champaca, Lotus / Mahogany wood, Amber, Black violet, Creamy notes. Fragrantica's older description paragraph names rose hip and Japanese apple, which are not in its pyramid; the pyramid was used. Many Euphoria flankers exist (Intense, Deep, Endless, EDT versions); this is the 2005 original women's EDP.

jovanmusk.name: Musk for Women
jovanmusk.source: Fragrantica gives four notes without a pyramid; placed by volatility
jovanmusk.research_note: Neither Fragrantica ('Fragrance Notes') nor Parfumo gives a pyramid; both list the same four notes (Parfumo order: Musk, Neroli, Bergamot, Jasmine). Fragrantica names it 'Musk'; Parfumo 'Musk for Women' (marketed by Coty). Fragrantica says it is sold as 25 and 60 ml Cologne Concentrate Spray, 100 ml Cologne Spray, 10 ml Musk Oil and 70 ml body spray; perfume.com lists 60 and 96 ml Cologne Concentrate Spray; Nice One's listing is titled 'Jovan Musk For Women - Cologne Spray', so check which format the catalogue item is. UNVERIFIED: a search summary (source page not identified or read) gave a pyramid with heart Spice, Lavender and base Sandalwood, Tonka Beans, and Amazon titles mention amber; neither was confirmed on a page read, so they are not used.

quatre.name: Quatre pour Femme
quatre.research_note: Fragrantica page name is 'Boucheron Quatre'; retailers call it 'Quatre pour Femme' EDP. Fragrantica's own description gives a different breakdown: top bitter orange, red currant, green tangerine, lemon, grapefruit; heart sambac jasmine, rose, wild strawberry, peach, apple; base golden woods, cedar, cashmere, musk, vanilla, caramel (red currant is not in its pyramid). A search snippet attributed to the brand site (fr.boucheron.com, domain no longer resolves, not read) lists head Bitter Orange, Red Currant Sparks; heart Sambac Jasmine Absolute, Rose Absolute; base Golden Woods, Musk. Parfumo cross-check not usable: the Parfumo URL /Perfumes/Boucheron/Quatre returned an unrelated 1999 unisex entry with invented note names (see summary). The Nice One concentration evidence is the product title as listed on the Nice One page read (https://niceonesa.com/en/calvin-klein-ckin2u-for-women-eau-de-toilette-100ml-n5567); the product page itself (https://niceonesa.com/en/boucheron-quatre-for-women-eau-de-parfum-100ml-n779) was not opened.

paradiso.name: Paradiso
paradiso.research_note: Fragrantica description: launched February 2015 (Coty), perfumer Louise Turner, sold as 30, 50 and 75 ml Eau de Parfum; description names the base as cypress, parasol pine and pink laurel. No independent second source read: the Parfumo page returned invented notes (see summary), so it was discarded. The Nice One concentration evidence is the product title as listed on the Nice One page read (https://niceonesa.com/en/calvin-klein-ckin2u-for-women-eau-de-toilette-100ml-n5567); the product page itself (https://niceonesa.com/en/roberto-cavalli-paradiso-for-women-eau-de-parfum-n6171) was not opened.

cavalliedp.name: Roberto Cavalli Eau de Parfum
cavalliedp.research_note: Notes agree across Fragrantica page, Fragrantica launch article (pink pepper / orange blossom / tonka bean, vanilla, benzoin) and Parfumo (Pink pepper / Orange blossom / Benzoin, Vanilla, Tonka bean). IDENTITY DOUBT on 'snake-skin bottle': no source read describes this bottle as snakeskin. Fragrantica says 'golden shades and leopard print decorate the bottle design and packaging'; its photo shows a smooth gold oval bottle with an animal-striped collar and a gold tiara stopper with the RC initials. Nice One's 'Roberto Cavalli For Women - Eau de Parfum' shows this same bottle, so the catalogue item matches the 2012 EDP. The snake motif belongs to other Cavalli bottles: the 2002 original 'Roberto Cavalli' (tall bottle with a snake coiled at the neck; notes Magnolia, Red Apple, Bergamot, Mandarin / Wild Orchid, Rosemary, Freesia, Honeysuckle / Amber, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Cedar, Musk) and Serpentine (2005). Retailers sometimes sell the 2012 EDP as 'Roberto Cavalli Signature'.

paradisoazzurro.name: Paradiso Azzurro
paradisoazzurro.research_note: Fragrantica: perfumer Louise Turner, turquoise diamond-shaped bottle, sold as 30, 50 and 75 ml Eau de Parfum. No second pyramid source read (Parfumo skipped after it began serving invented notes). The Nice One concentration evidence is the product title as listed on the Nice One page read (https://niceonesa.com/en/calvin-klein-ckin2u-for-women-eau-de-toilette-100ml-n5567); the product page itself (https://niceonesa.com/en/roberto-cavalli-paradiso-azzurro-for-women-eau-de-parfum-n6077) was not opened.

guessseductive.name: Seductive
guessseductive.research_note: The original is an EAU DE TOILETTE (Parfumo: 'Seductive, Guess 2010, Eau de Toilette', marketed by Interparfums, perfumer Veronique Nyberg). The 'Eau De Parfum, 75Ml' store listing is a mislabel: the Amazon.sa page titled 'GUESS Seductive For girls - Eau De Parfum, 75Ml' (ASIN B0041FXETY) states 'Fragrance concentration: Eau de Toilette' in its own specifications, ranks in Women's Eau de Toilette, and the same ASIN is sold on amazon.com as '2.5 oz 75 ml EDT Spray' (search result title). No women's Seductive EDP with different notes was found: Fragrantica's Guess designer list has only the 2010 original plus flankers (I'm Yours, Wild Summer, Sunkissed, Noir Women, Charm, Flirt, Kiss, Red, Blue, Dream, Desire Women), and Parfumo's Guess list shows only the EDT and a Fragrance Mist for the original. Parfumo pyramid agrees (Blackcurrant, Bergamot, Pear / Jasmine, Orange blossom, Iris / Cashmere wood, Vanilla, Frankincense); the Amazon.sa description gives the same notes.

dgpourfemme.name: Dolce&Gabbana Pour Femme
dgpourfemme.research_note: Pyramid read from the Fragrantica page. Page text: the 2012 relaunch was released as 25, 50 and 100 ml Eau de Parfum. Distinct from the 1992 original Dolce&Gabbana (Fragrantica 484) and Pour Femme Intense 2013 (18837). Perfumers Jean-Pierre Mary and Martine Pallix.

erospourfemme.name: Eros Pour Femme
erospourfemme.research_note: Fragrantica page 28958 is the original 2014 release; its text says it is available as 30, 50 and 100 ml EDP (first launched in Italy, December 2014). The EDT is a separate 2016 page (39355). Small wording difference on the same page: the editorial paragraph gives the heart as 'lemon, sambac jasmine absolute, jasmine infusion and peony' while the pyramid lists 'Lemon Blossom'. Perfumers Alberto Morillas, Olivier Cresp, Nathalie Lorson.

lapanthere.name: La Panthère
lapanthere.research_note: Fragrantica spells it 'La Panthere' (no accent); Cartier uses 'La Panthère'. Page text: available as 30, 50 and 75 ml Eau de Parfum; perfumer Mathilde Laurent. The editorial paragraph describes the idea as gardenia plus musk with a styrallyl-acetate top (rhubarb, strawberry, dried fruit, apple, apricot) and oakmoss; the pyramid above is the longer Fragrantica list. Distinct from La Panthere Extrait (27563) and La Panthere Legere 2015 (29360). No second source read.

elieleparfum.name: Le Parfum
elieleparfum.research_note: Page text: available as 30, 50 and 90 ml Eau de Parfum; perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. Editorial paragraph names jasmine grandiflorum and sambac in the heart and a 'rose honey accord' with cedar and patchouli in the base, consistent with the pyramid. Distinct from Le Parfum Eau de Toilette 2012 (15178) and Eau de Parfum Intense 2013 (18517). The id is spelled 'elliesaab'; the house is 'Elie Saab'.

narcisoforheredp.name: For Her Eau de Parfum
narcisoforheredp.research_note: This is the pink-bottle EDP: the page says it was launched in 2006 'in the pink bottle and the black box', after the original EDT. The EDT is a separate page (Narciso Rodriguez For Her, 209, listed as 2003; the EDP page text says the EDT dates from 2004). Perfumers Christine Nagel and Francis Kurkdjian.

crystalnoir.name: Crystal Noir
crystalnoir.research_note: Sources disagree on coconut. Fragrantica 631 (plain 'Crystal Noir', 2004, Antoine Lie) puts Coconut first in the heart. Parfumo's EDP page lists top Ginger, Cardamom, Pepper; heart Gardenia, Orange blossom, Peony; base Sandalwood, Musk, Amber (no coconut). Fragrantica's separate EDT page (67502) matches Parfumo: top Pepper, Cardamom, Ginger; middle Gardenia, Orange Blossom, Peony; base Sandalwood, Musk, Amber. Concentration: Fragrantica 631 does not state it in its text; it is taken as the EDP because Fragrantica lists the EDT separately and Parfumo's EDP page gives the same year and perfumer. Also distinct from Crystal Noir Parfum 2024 (92276).

myburberry.name: My Burberry
myburberry.source: Burberry's own eight notes; Fragrantica adds ten that neither the brand nor its own description names
myburberry.research_note: Sources disagree on the length of the list. Fragrantica's pyramid (above) is much longer than the brand's. Burberry's official product description (us.burberry.com redirected to int.burberry.com; notes found in the page's product data): top sweet pea and bergamot; heart geranium leaf, golden quince and freesia; base patchouli, damask rose and centifolia rose. Fragrantica's Mandarin Orange, Grapefruit, Lemon, Peach, Green Notes, Gardenia, Passionfruit, Musk, Leather and Violet do not appear in the brand text, and Fragrantica's own editorial paragraph gives only the brand notes. Perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. Distinct from My Burberry Eau de Toilette (31037), Limited Edition (28680) and Festive EDP (32323).

thescentforher.name: Boss The Scent For Her
thescentforher.research_note: Fragrantica shows only five main accords. Page text: available as 30, 50 and 100 ml EDP; the editorial describes the base as roasted cocoa. No perfumer is named on the page. Distinct from the later EDT, Intense, Le Parfum (71501) and Magnetic flankers.

interditrouge.name: L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge
interditrouge.research_note: Fragrantica's name is 'L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge'; concentration is in the name. Perfumers Dominique Ropion, Anne Flipo, Fanny Bal. Not the 2023 flanker L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge Ultime (83865).

guccibamboo.name: Bamboo
guccibamboo.research_note: Page text: launched spring 2015, available as 50 and 75 ml Eau de Parfum. No perfumer is named on the page. Distinct from Gucci Bamboo Eau de Toilette 2016 (38345) and Limited Edition 2017 (43114).

dynasty.name: Dynasty
dynasty.research_note: IDENTITY: the Amazon.sa listing 'Lattafa Dynasty EDP Unisex 3.4 Fl Oz' is ASIN B0FK3NXQ8G: byline 'Visit the Lattafa Store', Manufacturer Lattafa, model LD100U, Date First Available 18 August 2025, Fragrance concentration Eau de Parfum. Its bullets give the same pyramid as Fragrantica's Dynasty by Lattafa Perfumes (2025, Woody Spicy, for women and men, perfumer Alex Lee) and as lattafa.com's Dynasty page (Unisex, 100 ML, no sub-brand shown). So the maker is Lattafa's main line, not Lattafa Pride or Maison Alhambra; searches turned up no Dynasty from those houses, but those searches were not exhaustive. RATINGS: on 25 September 2026 the Amazon.sa page showed 1,402 ratings (4.4 stars), not about 14,000; the 14,000 figure may be a misreading of 1,402 or may belong to another listing.

aroubjazal.name: Jazal
aroubjazal.source: Nice One's product page (no Fragrantica entry)
aroubjazal.research_note: Pyramid read from Nice One's product description (Eau De Parfum, 80ml; 'Launched in 2024'; 'Fragrance Family: Oriental, Floral'). Arabic page: المكونات العليا البرغموت، الفلفل الوردي؛ الوسطى العود، العنبر؛ القاعدية جلد الغزال، المسك ('Suede' = جلد الغزال). Nice One's Specifications tab is incomplete (Middle 'Amber - Oud', Base 'Suede' only). A third-party retailer (Moonfume, read through a fetch summary) gives gender 'الجنسين - رجالي - نسائي' and lists the middle as oud only. No Fragrantica page found, so no accords (Fragrantica's 'AROUB' by PEARLA NERA, 2022, is a different perfume). Aroub's own website was not found; searches surfaced only its Instagram and X accounts, and I did not independently confirm that Aroub is a Saudi house. NAME CLASH: Al Sulaiman Oud sells a different 'عطر جزل 80مل' (alsulimanoud.com; notes oud, bergamot, 'Roman musk'); do not merge it with this one.

chocomusk.name: Choco Musk
chocomusk.source: the house's pyramid for the 6 ml oil (alrehabstore.com); Fragrantica gives a flat list
chocomusk.research_note: Fragrantica gives a flat list (Oriental Vanilla, for women and men, no year). Its page does not name a format, but a separate Fragrantica page exists for the spray (Choco Musk Eau de Parfum, 2023: Vanilla, Chocolate, Musk, Spices, Amber, Cinnamon, Sandal, Oriental Woodsy notes, Rose; https://www.fragrantica.com/perfume/Al-Rehab/Choco-Musk-Eau-de-Parfum-88083.html), so 20139 is taken as the oil. A third Fragrantica URL in search results (ALREHAB-PERFUMES/Choco-Musk-122906, '2026') redirected to the Fragrantica home page when opened. The house's store alrehabstore.com ('Choco musk 6 ml, Unisex - Fragrance oil'; the footer gives Al Rehab's commercial registration) gives a pyramid: Top Vanilla, Chocolate; Heart Musk, Spices, Cinnamon; Base Sandalwood, Oriental Woods, Rose. Its prose also names myrrh in the base. alrehab.com (Jeddah) lists a 3 ml oil described as cocoa with white musk, with no pyramid. Retailers sell it mostly as a 6 ml roll-on.

musksilk.name: Musk Silk
musksilk.source: Ajmal's Saudi store page for the 12 ml oil; Fragrantica gives a flat list
musksilk.research_note: The Fragrantica page read (Musk Silk, Oriental Floral, for women and men, no year) gives a flat list. Its page does not say it is the oil; I take it as the oil because Fragrantica lists the spray separately as Musk Silk Supreme (2022; Top Lily of the Valley; Middle Musk; Base Musk, Amber). DISAGREEMENT: Ajmal's Saudi store page for the oil (MUSK SILK, 12ML French Fragrance Oil, Unisex Attar) lists Top Lily Of The Valley; Heart Musk; Base Musk, Amber. That is identical to Fragrantica's Musk Silk Supreme (spray) pyramid and differs from the oil's Fragrantica list (no Tolu Balsam or Vanilla). Ajmal's UAE page for the oil (Perfume Oil, Unisex, 12/24/60 gm; tags Floral, Musk, Ambery) contradicts itself: one paragraph names lavender and cedarwood in the heart and sandalwood, cedarwood, vetiver and caramel in the base; another names pomegranate, strawberry and peony on top, lily of the valley in the heart and a powdery wood base. For a Saudi catalogue the Saudi store's pyramid is the house's own claim for the exact product sold here. Marked partial because the Fragrantica entry's format is inferred and the house's sources conflict.

musamamwhite.name: Musamam White Intense
musamamwhite.research_note: Fragrantica: Oriental Floral, for women and men, 2023, perfumer Gaël Montero. lattafa-usa.com (page title 'Unisex 100ML Edp Spray') gives exactly the Fragrantica pyramid. lattafa.com (Size 100 ML, Fragrance type Unisex) gives a shorter one: Top Bergamot, Orange, Spices; Heart Ylang, Coconut, Ambroxan; Base Sandalwood, Benzoin (it omits Mahonial and Musk).

moonlightpatchouli.name: Moonlight Patchouli
moonlightpatchouli.source: the house's pyramid (Van Cleef & Arpels and Parfumo agree); Fragrantica's differs
moonlightpatchouli.research_note: IDENTITY: the requested year 2009 is wrong for this perfume. Fragrantica and Parfumo both give 2016 (perfumer Sonia Constant); 2009 is when the Collection Extraordinaire line began. Marketed for women and men (unisex) on both databases. Sources disagree sharply on the pyramid. Fragrantica (above): top Patchouli Leaf, Cacao, Woodsy Notes; middle Bulgarian Rose, Iris Flower; base Suede, Leather, Fruity Notes. The official Van Cleef & Arpels product page: 'Top notes: Bergamot, Pink peppercorn; Heart notes: Rose, Iris; Base notes: Patchouli, Suede accord'. Parfumo (marked source-backed and verified) matches the brand: top Pink pepper, Bergamot; heart Rose, Iris; base Patchouli, Suede. Fragrantica's placement of patchouli in the top and leather/fruity notes in the base looks like it was built from the brand's prose ('suede accord, imbued with leather and fruity accents') rather than its pyramid. The brand pyramid is the better-supported one. Not to be confused with Moonlight Patchouli Le Parfum 2022 (Fragrantica 77937).
